# Agents (synthetic clean fixture for the secret rules)

- Never paste tokens such as ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx in issues.
- Documentation keys like AKIAEXAMPLEFAKE12345 are placeholders.
- sk-learn-style-estimator-interfaces are not keys.
- Public key blocks (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----) are fine.
- The connection string uses AccountKey=<storage-key>.
- Slack placeholders like xoxb-your-token-here are ignored.
- A JWT header alone, eyJFAKEheaderOnly, is not a token.
- Set password: see the team vault.
